À La Carte Dining

Your à la carte favourites, from heritage plates to premium indulgences.

Discover another side of Carousel with our à la carte menu in Singapore designed for guests who want choice, comfort and quality beyond the buffet. From familiar local favourites to global classics and premium sharing dishes, the menu brings together the craft of Carousel’s kitchens in a more flexible dining format.

Whether you are looking for a quick meal, a comforting hotel classic, a family-friendly option, or a more indulgent dining moment, our à la carte menu offers something for every appetite. Enjoy Singapore heritage dishes, Italian favourites, hearty burgers, seafood, premium meats, desserts and beverages in the welcoming setting of Royal Plaza on Scotts.

A Curated À La Carte Dining Experience

Our à la carte menu brings together a wide range of dishes across multiple categories, making it suitable for different dining occasions:

  • Singapore heritage favourites such as Hainanese Chicken Rice and Jason’s Lobster Laksa
  • Global classics including Fish & Chips, burgers, wraps and club sandwiches
  • Italian-inspired dishes including Burrata Salad, hand-stretched Two-Worlds Pizza and Alaskan King Crab Aglio Olio
  • Premium indulgences such as caviar, sashimi, wagyu, lobster and Alaskan king crab
  • Comforting desserts including Signature Bread & Butter Pudding and Dark Chocolate Lava
  • Kids’ favourites, coffee, tea, soft drinks, juices and still or sparkling water

Each section is designed to offer variety while keeping the dining experience easy to navigate.

Ideal for Hotel Guests and Flexible Dining

Perfect for hotel guests, business travellers, families and diners in Orchard Road, the à la carte menu is ideal when you want the Carousel experience without choosing the buffet. It gives guests the flexibility to enjoy a single dish, share a signature platter, order something light, or build a more indulgent meal.

This is dining on your terms. Choose a simple classic, return for a heritage favourite, or go all out with lobster, king crab, wagyu and caviar.

Why Choose Our À La Carte Menu

  • Flexible dining beyond the buffet experience
  • Singapore heritage dishes, global favourites and premium options
  • Suitable for quick meals, relaxed dining and sharing occasions
  • Family-friendly choices, including items for little ones
  • Desserts and beverages available to complete the meal
  • Prepared by our Halal-certified kitchens at Royal Plaza on Scotts

Designed for everyday cravings and special moments alike, the à la carte menu offers a more personal way to enjoy Carousel’s culinary range. Whether you are dining solo, sharing with family, hosting a casual meeting, or treating yourself to something more indulgent, there is a dish for the moment.

Please note that the last order is at 8.30pm.
